description: Header file defining functions and structures related to reftable writing, including buffer management, hash setting, and serialization functions.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets the hash value in a reftable buffer at a specified index using the provided enum hash identifier.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates and returns a reftable writer object that writes to a string buffer with specified options.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Serializes reftable references and logs into a buffer according to provided options.
